title: Neighbor From Hell Finally Get What He Deserves
description:
On May 5th, 2024. Multiple officers were dispatched to a residence regarding two hostile neighbours. On one side, the woman is mad that the man keeps putting unwanted property on her property & on the other side the man says that it isn’t her property and can put what he wants on there. The two escalated things and according to the woman, the man threatened her with a gun and said he was going to shoot her. All this took place before the man had work.

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
